summary: Six pixel loading indicators (orbit, snake, helix, scan, rain, pulse); clicking one finishes it with a check before it restarts.

events.name: finish
events.description: Fires when a loader is finished, by click, Finish all or `finish()`. `loader` is `Orbit`, `Snake`, `Helix`, `Scan`, `Rain` or `Pulse`.

methods.description: Shows the check on loader 0 to 5 for 1.6 seconds, then restarts it, and fires `finish`. Other values are ignored.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` naming all six loaders. It is not focusable and exposes no busy or progress state.
Finishing a single loader requires a pointer; "Finish all" is a native button.
motion: With reduced motion, each loader shows a still frame; the finish check still appears.
notes: The loaders are a 3 by 2 gallery on a 216px tall canvas and animate continuously while on screen, except under reduced motion. They are visual only and carry no progress value.
